name: Butter-Toasted King Crab Rolls with Chives & Potato Chips

ingredients.name: king crab leg & claw (pre-cooked), thawed if frozen

instructions.primary_message: Crack crab legs and claws, then pick out the crabmeat (you should have about 3 cups loosely packed crabmeat). Gently break the crabmeat into bite-sized pieces, picking out any small pieces of shell that may have been missed. Place in a small bowl and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lemon
2 stick celery
1 small pkg chives

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice.
Chop chives into small pieces. Add half to the bowl along with mayo, pepper, and salt, then stir to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining chives for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
½ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add crabmeat to the bowl with the dressing. Gently stir to combine and set aside.
Melt butter in the microwave or a small saucepan.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Gently open up the rolls (making sure to keep one side attached), then brush the insides with melted butter.
Once the skillet is hot, add buns, butter-side down, and toast until golden brown, 30-60 seconds. Remove to a plate.
Divide toasted buns between plates, fill with crab salad, and top with reserved chives. Serve with potato chips and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (7.5 oz) bag potato chips, kettle cooked
